id: title:Gilbert09:treat x payment required errors as non retryable

review.posthog_relevance: Adds payment-required status handling to the ingestion error dictionary, potentially preventing unnecessary retry loops for Twitter/X API credit exhaustion.
review.reason: Adds a 402 status entry to the non-retryable error dictionary, with a comment noting that this mirrors credential validation and that retrying won't refill credits.
review.uncertainty: The exact implementation and its complete context are not fully supplied, and the benefit of this change is not independently verified.

observations.limitations: Only P1.F1.H1 is supplied. No score assigned. No tier assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a 402 status entry to the non-retryable error dictionary, with a comment noting that this mirrors credential validation and that retrying won't refill credits.
observations.code_quote: "402 Client Error: Payment Required for url: https://api.x.com": "Your X developer project has run out of API credits. Add credits in the X developer portal, then try again.",
observations.posthog_connection: This could prevent PostHog from repeatedly retrying Twitter/X ingestion after a project's prepaid credits are exhausted, potentially avoiding unnecessary API calls and clearer user guidance.
